hook: A tidal disruption flare shows a carbon emission doublet for the first time, hinting at a dense envelope
summary: Spectra from the Very Large Telescope reveal a C IV doublet near 5800 angstroms in the off-nuclear tidal disruption event 2025abcr, a first for such events. The authors attribute it to fluorescence and photon trapping like that in Wolf-Rayet winds, which favors a compact, dense envelope. This rests on one event and a proposed mechanism not yet checked with radiative-transfer models.
title: Identification of the C IV $\lambda\lambda$5801, 5812 Emission in the Off-Nuclear TDE 2025abcr
